authorship: Original suggested workflows; linked sources document underlying controls and creative topics.

methods.intent: Keep intentional transients while removing unwanted boundaries.
steps: Choose the section and save a separate edit.
Trim at deliberate boundaries; compare short fades against the unedited transient.
Render the edit and check length, clipping and source preservation.
native_or_manual: Clip arrangement, crossfades between clips and warping
methods.compare: Same musical section at matched level; listen later for clicks and lost attack.

methods.intent: Choose a sample for a musical role before stacking processing.
steps: State the role: transient, low body, texture or hook.
Try a small trim/reverse/fade variation and keep the original.
For rhythmic remapping, consult Simpler/Sampler and warp settings in Live.
native_or_manual: Pitch, warp, slices mapped to MIDI and audition
methods.compare: Check pitch, groove and layering by listening later; a waveform alone cannot choose the best sample.

methods.intent: Make the musical priority clear before mastering.
steps: Name the focal element and choose a representative loud section.
Change one gain, filter or ducking decision at a time using an explicit stem plan.
Recheck quieter sections, mono loss and available headroom.
execute_here: mix: gain, pan, high-pass, compression and kick-keyed ducking
audio_analyze: bands, dynamics and mono diagnostics
native_or_manual: Auditory masking, emotional focus and monitor translation
methods.compare: Compare the same section at matched level; keep a move only when the stated goal improves.

methods.intent: Use effects to create depth and movement without hiding the focal part.
steps: Choose the purpose: short room, long atmosphere, rhythmic repeat or distortion texture.
Try a return-path filter, timing or ducking change while keeping the dry part available.
Print an alternate stem and inspect tails, low-frequency build-up and mono compatibility.
execute_here: mix: supplied dry/wet stems and ducking
native_or_manual: Load/automate Echo, reverb or saturation and render its return in Live
methods.compare: Listen later to dry versus wet at matched level; more width or reverb is not automatically better.

methods.intent: Explore an original style without requiring an artist template.
steps: Choose one axis: groove, density, timbre, harmony or spatial depth.
Make two named versions while keeping the other axes steady.
Record the intended difference and explicit user feedback after comparison.
execute_here: sample_edit and master_versions: separate file variants
native_or_manual: New MIDI patterns, harmonic rewriting, arrangement and native effects automation
methods.compare: Select an interesting musical direction through user feedback; technical measurements do not decide style.

methods.intent: Use a supplied recording to explain a goal, without cloning it.
steps: Ask which passage and attributes matter: bass, tone, width, dynamics, arrangement or effects.
Select comparable sections and create a hashed reference brief.
Treat normalized band and dynamics differences as diagnostic clues; plan a bounded change and a later listening comparison.
execute_here: reference: local section metrics, user notes and candidate deltas
native_or_manual: Perceptual similarity, stem attribution and subjective acceptance
methods.compare: A reference can demonstrate one attribute only; it does not mandate the entire artist sound.

methods.intent: Compare impact and density with loudness bias reduced.
steps: Use the same approved premaster for every version.
Render dynamic, balanced and dense starting profiles with measured ceilings and reduction budgets.
Compare attenuated copies at a shared LUFS level, then use human feedback to choose a direction.
execute_here: master_versions: up to three named masters, reports and level-matched copies
native_or_manual: Tonal artistry, codec delivery decisions and perceptual distortion assessment
methods.compare: Profiles vary this limiter’s targets and timing; they are not genre standards or vendor algorithms.

methods.intent: Make low-end roles and note timing cooperate.
steps: Choose which part owns the sustained low body, then compare kick tail against the bass note length.
Try one deliberate separation: shorter bass gate, changed onset, less low body or kick-keyed ducking.
Inspect bass recovery, mono/sub behavior and the loud section before the master.
native_or_manual: Kick synthesis/tuning, sample pitch and exact native compressor settings
methods.compare: Level-match the same phrase; reject a move that weakens the intended groove even if headroom increases.

methods.intent: Give the backbeat body and snap without uncontrolled layering.
steps: Pick one foundation sample; add only a complementary attack or texture if it serves the role.
Check summed mono timing and polarity; preserve both originals.
Set length and room send to leave the next hat/lead gesture clear.
execute_here: sample_edit: trim/fades/gain; mix: explicit layer gain/pan; audio_analyze: mono diagnostics
native_or_manual: Polarity/time alignment, audition and choosing body/attack layers; authored private DSP is not a sample-alignment endpoint
methods.compare: Compare the sum at matched level; a louder layer is not automatically a better snare.

methods.intent: Build articulation and forward movement around the backbeat.
steps: Choose a clear eighth/sixteenth subdivision and accent pattern.
Apply timing to selected offbeats and quieter replies; avoid randomizing every layer.
Shorten/choke open hats where the closed hat should interrupt them; vary density between sections.
native_or_manual: MIDI rewrite, native Groove Pool and choke groups; private authored sample gating
methods.compare: Judge pulse, harshness and space with the full groove, then inspect mono/peak behavior.

methods.intent: Choose a loop for a defined role and verify its timing.
steps: Read source/usage provenance, header duration/rate and any filename tempo hint separately.
Confirm downbeat and musical length; a filename BPM is not detected tempo or verified pitch.
Choose native warp/slicing manually or use an exact-tempo local loop; retain the original and fade edit boundaries.
native_or_manual: Native warp modes, transient slice mapping, BPM/key detection and licensed sample selection
methods.compare: Check downbeat drift over the whole song and listen for transient/phase damage; do not equate resampling with pitch-preserving warp.

methods.intent: Place the backbeat and chords in a controlled space.
steps: Choose a short room for cohesion or a longer tail for a breakdown; state its musical role.
Keep the source clear with a filtered send and deliberate predelay.
Reduce or duck the wet return when the next foreground phrase arrives.
execute_here: mix: explicit bounced return stems and gain; sample_edit for printed variants
native_or_manual: General native routing/predelay/reverb controls; offline Pedalboard example is a private authored renderer, not a generic MCP effects endpoint
methods.compare: Compare wet/dry at similar perceived level in dense and sparse sections.

methods.intent: Make echoes answer phrases rather than crowd every note.
steps: Choose a tempo subdivision and a few phrase ends to feed it.
Filter and attenuate repeats; use a finite decay budget.
Change send amount for transitions while keeping the dry hook recognizable.
execute_here: mix: pre-rendered delay return gains; sound_design: observed plugin controls only
native_or_manual: Native send automation, feedback routing and private finite tapped-delay authoring
methods.compare: Inspect repeated peaks, tail boundaries and mono; listening decides whether the echoes support the rhythm.

methods.intent: Add body or texture while preserving the intended attack.
steps: Name the missing role before processing.
Keep a dry source and make one filtered parallel color layer; match its level against bypass.
Recheck low-frequency buildup, transient loss and the whole phrase.
execute_here: mix: bounced parallel layers and supported compressor controls
native_or_manual: Native Drum Buss/Saturator/parallel racks, transient shaping and private nonlinear DSP
methods.compare: An increase in harmonics or RMS is not proof of better impact; retain the unprocessed version.

methods.intent: Develop a full song through contrasting sections.
steps: Use the requested length; local full-song authoring defaults to120seconds unless the user chooses another duration.
Plan distinct groove, bass, register, density and send changes; retain a recognizable motif.
Write transition fills and a supported ending, then render one complete private song before a bounded alternate.
execute_here: prepare: guidance; methods/knowledge: selective retrieval; mix/master: authored bounced files
native_or_manual: Full composition, MIDI authoring and arrangement; no arbitrary full-song generation or native export endpoint
methods.compare: Compare actual section notes/events and later audition the complete arc, not only a peak/loudness score.
